SPECIFICATION FOR 

MALE STUD TEE BODY ( STUD RUN ) FOR 

OIL-HYDRAULIC COUPLING 

PART 1 MADE FROM FORG1NGS 



1. Scope — Specifies the dimensions, material and other requirements for male stud tee body ( stud 
run ) made from forgings, for use \n oil-hydraulic systems.

for ferrule couplings used in oil-hydraulic systems : Part I General \ Type B may be used, if required, in which case 
the designation shall be:

IS: 10433 (Part I)- 1983 

3. Material — Steel conforming to class 1A of IS : 1875-1978 ' Carbon steel billets, blooms, slabs and 
bars for forgings {fourth revision )' or any other steel as agreed to between the user and the 
manufacturer. 

4. Surface Protection — These male stud run tee bodies shall be phosphated to Class A2 IS : 3018* 
1968 Phosphate treatment of iron and steel for protection against corrosion ', unless otherwise agreed to 
between the user and the manufacturer. 

5. General Requirements 

5.1 These male stud run tee bodies are intended for assembly in accordance with Type B of IS : 10480- 
1983 'Stud run tee coupling assemblies for oil-hydraulic systems \ 

5.2 For details not covered in this standard, reference shall be made to IS : 8805 ( Part I )-1978. 

6. Designation -— A male stud tee body of light series L for 22 mm outside diameter of tube and 
conforming to this standard shall be designated as: 

Stud Run Tee Body L22 IS : 10433 ( Part I ) 

7. ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards Institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard covers male stud tee body made from forging only. The tee-bodies made from bar 
stock are covered in IS : 10433 ( Part II ) ' Male stud tee body ( stud run ) for oil-hydraulic couplings: 
Part II Made from bar stock \ 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from the following standards: 

BS : 4368 Carbon and stainless steel compression couplings for tube 

Part I : 1972 Heavy series ( metric ) 

Part ill : 1974 Light series ( metric ), British Standards Institution ( BSI ) 

DIN 3914 : 1966 Non-soldered taper bush type pipe unions, used as an adaptor with parallel 
thread on screwed- in-end for use with union nut. Deutsches Institut fiir 
Normung ( DIN ).
